feeds.title: Team Jesus Magazine - Christian Lifestyle, News, and Events
feeds.description: Team Jesus Magazine is a digital Christian playbook created to honor God, and uplift and inform the body of Christ. As a playbook, our content instructs, exhorts, and encourages Christian living through practical, actionable, biblically-based articles, news, events, and information affecting the Christian community.

feeds.title: iBelieve.com
feeds.description: At iBelieve, women from every walk in life team up to write from personal experience in order to help singles, dating couples, newlyweds, married couples, or widows. Aside from their blog posts, they also have multiple daily devotionals for young women to help them in their relationships with God and others.

feeds.title: The Praying Woman
feeds.description: Christian prayer and devotional blogs for women written by female bloggers. Daily devotions, relationship advice, encouragement, and more!

feeds.title: Belle Brita - A Christian Feminist Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Brita Long writes about feminism, relationships, faith, Crohn's Disease, and so much more at this Christian feminist lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Kristin Sterk
feeds.description: As a Christ-follower, wife, stay at home mom, blogger, author, and advanced heart failure patient, my desire is to encourage others in those same roles, through honest and real conversation. May you be inspired to embrace YOUR story of God's grace in your own life, through simple, grace-filled living.

feeds.title: The Peaceful Haven
feeds.description: The Peaceful Haven is an engaging lifestyle blog. Janelle blogs about life including homemaking, parenting, autism, gluten-free living, health, finances, simple living all from a Christian perspective.

feeds.title: Today's Christian Living
feeds.description: Joanna Sanders is a graduate of Villanova University and Moody Theological Seminary. Her blog name 'The Landing' comes from the account of the Ark resting on the mountain, creating a settled place - a landing - for man to start over, which echoes her new life in Christ.

feeds.title: becominghistapestry.com
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Brenda. I am a Christian, a wife, a homeschooling mom, a daughter, a granddaughter, a sister and a friend. I want to be my Lord and Savior's tapestry. But for now, I am becoming, I am in the process of becoming, of allowing my Master to weave the various threads of my life into His Masterpiece. The purpose of this blog is to bring the Lord glory by sharing with you, tidbits of my life, to encourage and edify you as we journey along this path called life.

feeds.title: Positively Gospel
feeds.description: Positively Gospel is a trusted source for the latest news in Gospel music, Christian music, lifestyle, culture, food, books and as well as reviews and interviews with recording artists and industry movers and shakers.

feeds.title: All Things Allison Marie
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Allison Marie, a Christian blogger. I write for college students, single girls, and teen girls seeking to encounter Jesus in their lives! I truly want to show you that you can honor God with your lifestyle. As Christian girls, that's not always easy. But it is possible.

feeds.title: The Abundant life Blog
feeds.description: The Abundant life features articles having the peace, joy, contentment, and love that Jesus died for us to have

feeds.title: P40 Ministries Blog
feeds.description: At P40 Ministries, our desire is to reach women of all ages with written words of truth, hope, and encouragement. We believe that God's mercies are new each morning, and we are here to help women of all walks of life understand God's mercy and love.

feeds.title: The Christian Heart
feeds.description: The Christian Heart shows how people display their love for Jesus in their day-to-day lives. Every story describes how everyday people live out their Christian faith.

feeds.title: Sonoma Christian Home
feeds.description: The fastest growing Christian women's magazine online! Delivering daily inspiration on food, faith, family, design & wholesome entertainment.

feeds.title: Living the Sweet Wife - Hope for joyful marriages and healthy lifestyles! Blog
feeds.description: Blogging for Christian marriage advice, relationship tips, & healthy lifestyle inspiration.

feeds.title: Berries and Grace
feeds.description: Berries and Grace is a Christian Lifestyle blog sharing a dose of simplicity on faith, everyday living and great finds!

feeds.title: Writings & Worship - Christian Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Writings & Worship is a Christian lifestyle blog where you can find a wide range of posts. Find posts about faith, beauty, lifestyle, and photography.

feeds.title: Inspiring Changes
feeds.description: This is a Christian blog with amazing and inspiring content on Bible studies, Christian lifestyle guides, Christian fiction & stories, Life-changing experiences, Salvation write-ups, faith articles, and more.

feeds.title: Modern Day Christian Chick
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Marsha and my life is an open book. Sharing with you will prayerfully, allow me to use the life God gave me to make a difference in the life of someone else. I am Mother to three amazing women; Youth Ministry Director to kids I love like I birthed them myself; work full time as a 911 Dispatch Instructor and own my own company - Alpha & Omega Tactical Communication, LLC.

feeds.title: Stumbling Beauty
feeds.description: A stumbling journey creating beauty from ashes.

feeds.title: Do Better Everyday Blog
feeds.description: Do Better Everyday blog has been created by Maria aka Maz to encourage others to DoBetterEveryday. The main purpose of this blog is to carry as many people along with her on this journey to becoming better everyday in all areas of life: Spiritually, mentally, physically, emotionally, financially and in our relationships!

feeds.title: The Ayi
feeds.description: The name is Ayisat. I'm a lover of art, health, beauty, photography etc. I care about the little things people don't notice. Jesus is everything to me. I did not really have a reason to continue with this blog at first, but now I know. I've always wanted to share my story, so maybe this is it. It's not a very perfect or wonderful story but it's a God kept life, so it's worth it.

feeds.title: Best For Christ - Christian Lifestyle Magazine
feeds.description: BestForChrist goal is to help our readers to live and grow as Jesus' disciples not only during sacred moments, but also in everyday life. We do not want to be just 'Sunday Christians', but those who enjoy the love of God on a daily basis, every minute of the day, whether working, resting or praying.

feeds.title: Nomads in Christ
feeds.description: Welcome! As of the start of this blog (2/4/2021) I am 66 years young. I was raised in Reno, Nv. Where my daughter, two grandchildren and a great-grandaughter live. The purpose of this blog is to reach Christians who live full time in rvs, vans, homeless. etc. Bible resources, practical living tips, connect with others.

feeds.title: Mrs. Molly Wilcox Blog
feeds.description: Molly Wilcox, a writer based out of Nashville Tennessee sends out free weekly devotionals and share Christian lifestyle tips on her blog. As a Christian writer I make God's Word accessible to women with busy lives. We are leaning into the promises of God, living purposed, equipped, and brave today.

feeds.title: Doxa Magazine
feeds.description: Your Christian Magazine for a new generation of believers. It features human-interest stories, news, action items, information, and advice on a wide range of matters concerning Christians in their day-to-day living.

feeds.title: No Greater Love Blog - A Catholic faith and lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: My name is Maddy Barr and I am the brains behind this blog. MY mission is to encourage ladies to dive deeper into their faith, foster Christ-centered relationships, recognize their femininity and worth as daughters of God, and spread the faith as active parts of the New Evangelization.

feeds.title: Christina Semmens Blog
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome! I am an author, speaker, mentor and guide (or teacher in traditional parlance). I write, speak and mentor about how to live a life of purpose, peace and abundance in the pursuit of holiness, with an occasional article or two about popular culture (particularly books and movies) and their influence upon us. My primary goal is to encourage, challenge and empower people to say yes to the life that they were created for each and every day of their lives.

feeds.title: Today's Purpose Woman
feeds.description: A magazine that encourages inspires, motivates, empowers and success stories on women living a higher purpose - God's Purpose
